title: The Ultimate Red Sauce and Fantastic Posters From the Spanish Civil War
content:
Photo by Bill Holsinger-Robinson, via Flickr (https://www.flickr.com/photos/billhr/) Here's a couple of good posts that were shared on MetaFilter recently:

Looking to show your love with the ultimate red sauce? This link might do it. It features a slow cooked Italian-American tomato sauce by J. Kenji López-Alt and it's a flavor loaded, all-day affair that delivers deep, rich nostalgic goodness. It'll leave your kitchen smelling like Nonna's, even if you don't have one, because it's a love letter to old-school Italian-American comfort food. Shared by Lemkin, from Serious Eats: https://www.metafilter.com/208699/Kenji-Lpez-Alts-All-Day-Red-Sauce

Historian Fraser Raeburn commemorated Victory in Europe Day by sharing his personal collection of anti-fascist posters from the Spanish Civil War in this this fantastic Bluesky thread. Shared by signal: https://www.metafilter.com/208696/Camarada
author: Brandon Blatcher
